stages.title: 保護邊界
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「保護邊界」的模型及判讀，共六項獨立保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units develop protection boundaries through six separately saved modeling and interpretation tasks.

steps.title: 區域邊界：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「區域邊界」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for zone boundary.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「區域邊界」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。差動保護比較穿越明確邊界的電流。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「畫 CT 位置及未覆蓋區。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for zone boundary, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Differential protection compares currents across defined boundaries. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Mark CT locations and uncovered regions. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 畫 CT 位置及未覆蓋區。
steps.observationEn: Mark CT locations and uncovered regions.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「區域邊界」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping zone boundary verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「區域邊界」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「畫 CT 位置及未覆蓋區。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for zone boundary; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 差動保護比較穿越明確邊界的電流。
knowledge.textEn: Differential protection compares currents across defined boundaries.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 畫 CT 位置及未覆蓋區。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Mark CT locations and uncovered regions. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 以流入區域為正，假設兩端相量 +1000 A 與 −980 A，差流為 20 A；定義制動電流 (|I₁|+|I₂|)/2=990 A，差流比約 2.02%。這只是教學判讀，實際算法和門檻依裝置而異。
knowledge.textEn: With currents positive into a zone, +1000 A and −980 A give differential 20 A. Defining restraint as (|I₁|+|I₂|)/2 gives 990 A and ratio 2.02%; actual algorithms and thresholds are device-specific.

quiz.question: 審查「區域邊界」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for zone boundary?
options: 差動保護比較穿越明確邊界的電流。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「區域邊界」的驗證。
只調整「區域邊界」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Differential protection compares currents across defined boundaries.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping zone boundary verification.
Tuning the displayed zone boundary result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 差動保護比較穿越明確邊界的電流。 畫 CT 位置及未覆蓋區。
quiz.explanationEn: Differential protection compares currents across defined boundaries. Mark CT locations and uncovered regions.

steps.title: 區域邊界：量測與判讀
steps.objective: 針對「區域邊界」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。

steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。畫 CT 位置及未覆蓋區。 比較差異是否符合「差動保護比較穿越明確邊界的電流。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Mark CT locations and uncovered regions. Compare the result against: Differential protection compares currents across defined boundaries. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 畫 CT 位置及未覆蓋區。

steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「區域邊界」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping zone boundary verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「區域邊界」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for zone boundary; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

summary: 以邊界電流、CT 飽和與差動制動串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。

scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.
